name: Release identity
definition: Component-scoped major release identity with legacy UGTS-KC 5.0 alias.

name: Source register
definition: Content-hashed source and parent register without raw-source redistribution.

name: OperatorCell
definition: One content-addressed record co-addresses literal, glyph, semantics and field action.

name: Unicode scalar key
definition: Exact Unicode scalar sequence is a canonical cold-atlas lookup key.

name: UTF-8 literal key
definition: UTF-8 spelling is recorded and round-tripped without ASCII aliasing.

name: NFC normalization profile
definition: NFC is explicit; compatibility normalization is not silently applied.

name: Typed signature
definition: Every operator declares domain, codomain, arity and type parameters.

name: Canonical argument order
definition: One semantic port order is authoritative for each converse family.

name: Surface argument map
definition: Surface operands map explicitly to canonical semantic ports.

name: Semantic evaluator
definition: Literal dispatch selects a bounded typed semantic kernel.

name: Canonical glyph SDF
definition: A versioned capsule-union field represents the literal operator shape.

name: Set-field action
definition: Operator records declare predicates or sign-compatible field transforms.

name: Converse link
definition: Direct and converse cells reference each other by stable operator ID.

name: Operator content hash
definition: Every cell carries a canonical SHA-256 content address.

name: Provenance class
definition: Source motif, engineering normalization and measured evidence stay distinct.

name: Capability class
definition: Exact SDF, metric field, bound, residual, membership field and oracle remain distinct.

name: Signed set field
definition: phi_A = d(x,A) - d(x,X\A) under a declared metric profile.

name: Characteristic fallback
definition: Finite or non-metric sets can use a signed membership field.

name: Membership predicate
definition: x in A iff phi_A(x) <= 0 under the selected boundary policy.

name: Nonmembership predicate
definition: x notin A is the typed negation of membership.

name: Subset predicate
definition: A subseteq B is a quantified emptiness claim over A\B.

name: Proper subset predicate
definition: Proper inclusion adds non-equality to subset.

name: Set equality
definition: A=B is mutual inclusion under a common universe/profile.

name: Empty-set predicate
definition: Emptiness is exact only when the domain proof is complete.

name: Union field
definition: min(phi_A,phi_B) preserves the union sign.

name: Intersection field
definition: max(phi_A,phi_B) preserves the intersection sign.

name: Complement field
definition: -phi_A reverses inside and outside.

name: Difference field
definition: max(phi_A,-phi_B) preserves the sign of A\B.

name: Symmetric-difference field
definition: A sign-correct max/min formula represents A triangle B.

name: Field capability downgrade
definition: Composed fields never inherit exact-distance status without proof.

name: Finite-universe proof
definition: Exhaustive finite checks may issue exact relation certificates.

name: Interval/analytic proof
definition: Continuous global claims require analytic, interval or certified-cover evidence.

name: Sample-only nonproof
definition: A sampled LUT result is bounded evidence, not universal inclusion proof.

name: Klein-converse transform
definition: One transform reflects chart, swaps ports and toggles converse state.

name: Operator converse
definition: U maps to U-smile while preserving truth after operand exchange.

name: Operand swap
definition: Typed endpoints reverse rather than being reinterpreted in place.

name: Glyph reflection
definition: Canonical converse glyph is the x-reflection of the direct glyph.

name: Angular reflection
definition: theta maps to pi-theta on the reflective profile.

name: Orientation selector
definition: kappa is a semantic/topological selector and not an integrity bit.

name: Involution law
definition: Applying the Klein-converse transform twice returns the original state.

name: Reflective quotient
definition: Boundary gluing declares the actual orientation-reversing quotient.

name: Half-turn distinction
definition: A pi rotation remains distinct from a reflective Klein gluing.

name: Cold Unicode atlas
definition: The full literal record remains content-addressed outside hot SIMD state.

name: Hot 16-slot codebook
definition: A batch-local codebook maps four-bit slots to exact atlas cells.

name: Reserved-slot rejection
definition: Unassigned local codes reject rather than aliasing silently.

name: Codebook content hash
definition: Hot mappings are bound to the exact cold atlas.

name: Packed Set-Field Node 32
definition: A corrected 32-bit execution record carries local deltas and flags.

name: Integrity parity
definition: Bit 31 checks payload parity and remains separate from kappa.

name: Family/kappa extraction
definition: operator_id=(family<<1)|kappa enables converse-pair locality.

name: Signed log-radius delta
definition: An explicit int8 delta requires a stream scale/bias contract.

name: Cyclic angle delta
definition: An 8-bit angular delta has a declared 256-bin period.

name: Grammar path fragment
definition: Eight bits represent a bounded branch fragment, not an unbounded tree.

name: Local field flags
definition: Two bits carry profile-defined local status with declared meaning.

name: Active bit
definition: Bit zero is decoded and tested rather than silently dropped.

name: Stream header
definition: Atlas, codebook, chart, quantization and error contracts travel with nodes.

name: Block CRC
definition: Stream-level CRC supplements per-node parity and content hashes.

name: Scalar oracle
definition: Dependency-free scalar decoding is the conformance authority.

name: Branchless mask expansion
definition: Boolean selectors expand to full-lane masks before blending.

name: AVX2 profile
definition: Eight-lane extraction is specified behind the scalar oracle.

name: NEON profile
definition: Four-lane ARM decoding is a specified backend target.

name: Quantization certificate
definition: Angular/radial errors are calculated from the declared profile.

name: Event-margin guard
definition: Packed evaluation is accepted only below the relevant event margin.

name: UGTS authority handoff
definition: Pure operator evaluation cannot bypass support, compatibility and commit.

name: Validation and kill criteria
definition: Claims fail closed on hash, type, parity, exactness or evidence violations.
